item.tib: dbyangs can sgra dbyangs rgyal mo'i sgab chung bsam 'phel nor bu
item.coloph: de ltar sgra dbyangs rgyal mo la/ rtse gcig gsol ba gdab pa'i yan lag tu/ nye mkho'i sku bstod ku mud phreng ba/ sgo btsun nyi ri shel bzhin dad pas phul/ dge des bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus kun/ smra bsam rang dbang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
